changelog: v0.5.0: Add scripts/transform.py - derived columns + schema operations. Hand-rolled tokenizer + recursive-descent parser (no eval, no subprocess) supports arithmetic, string concat, parens, comparisons, function calls (upper/lower/strip/len/abs/round/int/float/str/replace/split/join/coalesce/year/month/day). Six ops: --add, --set, --drop, --rename, --cast (int/float/bool/string), --keep. Schema computed symbolically before streaming so empty cells in arithmetic don't crash the pipeline; per-row errors leave the derived value empty but continue processing. Bug fixed: schema-detection pass was evaluating expressions against empty rows. All 14 scripts now use the same safe-path policy and 0/1/2 exit codes.
summary: Local CSV / TSV / JSONL inspection and cleanup toolkit. Profile, validate, deduplicate, diff, preview (head/tail/random sample), filter with a safe predicate...
